name: Ransomware recovery

hiddenFacts.fact: Asset inventory and MFA coverage are incomplete.
Backups exist, but we have never timed a full restore.

goal: Sequence security baseline and tested recovery into a budget
opening: I'm the CSO of an insurer. A ransomware scare has made recovery our board priority.
script: Show what comes first under CIS IG1 before IG2.
Include a recovery exercise and training as budget lines.

expectations.description: Orders CIS IG1 foundations before IG2 enhancements
Prioritises isolated or immutable backups and measured restore testing
Uses security categories without introducing vendors; makes no assurance of immunity
